popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Daughter of Aegisthus and Clytemnestra; later tradition makes her Orestes' accuser or wife and mother of Penthilus — not Erigone of Icaria who hanged herself for Icarius.

popCulture.title: Erigone (daughter of Aegisthus)
popCulture.description: Mycenaean Erigone of the Atreid house — carefully distinct from Erigone daughter of Icarius.
